title: Model Bye-laws for Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) as Multi-Purpose Entities
overview: Guidelines adopted under the Ministry of Cooperation to transform 63,000+ functional PACS into vibrant, financially sustainable, multi-service economic hubs.
permitted_activities: Short-term, medium-term and long-term agricultural credit disbursement
Supply of certified agricultural inputs (Seeds, Fertilizers, Pesticides) at regulated MRP
Operation of Custom Hiring Centers (Tractors, Harvesters, Drone spraying)
Establishment of Cold storage, Godowns, Assaying & Grading infrastructure
LPG Distributorship, Petrol Pump outlets, and Community CSC delivery centers
Operation of Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samriddhi Kendras (PMKSK) and Jan Aushadhi Kendras (Affordable Generic Medicines)

governance_and_audit.enterprise_resource_planning: Standard ERP software onboarding mapped to NABARD state cooperative data pipeline
governance_and_audit.statutory_audit: Mandatory annual audit completed by certified chartered cooperative auditors within 6 months of financial year end
governance_and_audit.board_composition: Minimum 5 to 15 elected directors with statutory representation for women and SC/ST farmers

citations: Ministry of Cooperation Model Bye-Laws for PACS 2022
